rationale: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=200, epochs=40, batch_size=1, lr=0.0002, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (breast-ct-claude-agentic-uswin-search-20260703-01). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) READ iter-1..6: hr 0.6490/0.8193/0.8092(win16)/0.8208(h8,BEST)/0.8136(lr4e-4)/0.8094(c32). iter-6 c32 (7.025M params, backstop ep34) hr=0.809345 < iter-4 c24 0.820804 -> capacity bump REGRESSED, exactly like iter-3 win16 (0.809, ep32). (2) FAILURE MODE: raw REPRESENTATION capacity increases (window iter-3, channels iter-6) both REGRESS under the 20-min wall because their ~1.8x per-epoch cost cuts epochs (34-38 vs 40) and the c24 base already SATURATES val at ~0.82 (loss -> ~1e-6 every run). Combined with heads(iter-4,+0.0015) and lr(iter-5,-0.007) failing, hr ~0.82 looks like a DATA/GEOMETRY ceiling, not a capacity one. The untested lever is GRADIENT-UPDATE DENSITY: iter-1..6 all used batch_size=2 (100 steps/epoch on train_n=200). (3) ONE KNOB: batch_size 2 -> 1 (2x the optimizer steps/epoch = 200 steps/epoch); hold everything else at the iter-4 BEST (c24, epochs=40, lr=2e-4, swin_window=8, swin_heads=8, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: hr ~0.82 is optimization-granularity-limited, not representation-limited; halving batch to 1 doubles gradient updates per epoch, which for small-data (train_n=200) supervised training often finds a flatter/better minimum and lifts hr above 0.821. bs=1 is CHEAPER per-step (less memory) so 40 epochs still fits ~ the iter-2 14.5min budget (possibly slightly slower total due to 2x kernel launches; max_train_s=1000 backstop guards). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.821 at bs=1, gradient density is NOT the limiter -> confirms ~0.82 is the data/geometry ceiling for U-Swin on 512px breast under this budget; iter-8 then probes train_n (200->400, more data) as the last capacity-free lever. (5) HARD 20-min budget honored (max_train_s=1000 backstop); val_n=200 = whole val pool. (6) I self-drive to iter-20; dispatch iter-8 when iter-7 lands.
